summary: Sandbach United kick off their 2026/27 campaign against Stafford Town in what promises to be a competitive Premier Division opener, with both sides eyeing a return to the playoff positions they've occupied in recent seasons. The league saw some impressive performances on opening day, with Burscough and Trafford both securing convincing wins, setting the standard for what's shaping up to be another competitive year in the NWCFL. Admission is affordable with adults at £6, concessions £5, and under-16s just £2.
